answer_1.quote: In this work we study methods for long-term open-domain conversation. ... We study the performance of two long-context conversational architectures on this task: (i) retrieval-augmented generative models ; and (ii) a proposed read-write memory-based model that summarizes and stores conversation on the fly.

answer_2.quote: We report more automatic metrics (F1 and BLEU) in Appendix A, which yield similar conclusions.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation using crowdworkers. ... At the end of the conversation, an additional question collects an overall engagingness score (out of 5) for their speaking partner.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers evaluate partner responses for conversational attributes, checking boxes for referencing knowledge from previous/current sessions, and provide an overall engagingness score.
criteria: reference own topics from previous sessions
reference partner topics from previous sessions
